newsitem.title: USA: BBN says delays release of Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: BBN says delays release of Q3 results.

text.p: Internet service provider BBN Corp said it has delayed the release of it fiscal third quarter results for one week.
The results for the period ended March 31 were to be released today, but it has been moved to next Monday, a company spokesman said.
He declined to say why the news has been delayed.
Earlier, the company declined to comment after the New York Stock Exchange made an inquiry to the company regarding unusual activity in the company's shares.
In the past three trading sessions, BNN shares have risen to around 22 from 16 in unusually active trade.
Traders said the rise has been driven by market speculation that AT&T Corp is preparing a bid for BBN.
BBN unoffically ended Monday's NYSE trading session at 21-7/8, off an earlier session-high of 22-3/4, up 1-3/4.
